images.after: Who a personal loan suits, and who it doesn't
images.title: Is a personal loan a fit for you
images.alt: Comparison of when a personal loan tends to suit you, such as high-rate card debt and stable income, and when it doesn't, such as covering monthly bills.
images.caption: A loan changes the rate and the schedule. It doesn't fix spending that runs ahead of income.

columns.label: Tends to suit you
points: High-rate card balances, clearly lower loan rate
Stable income covers it even in a tight month

columns.label: Tends not to
points: Borrowing to cover ordinary monthly bills
The rate offered isn't lower than your cards

images.title: Do the arithmetic first
images.alt: Steps to test a consolidation loan: list card balances and APRs, total the loan cost with fees, compare with paying the cards, decide on the totals.
images.caption: A smaller monthly payment can still mean a bigger total if the term is longer.

items.title: List your cards
items.text: Add up the balances and note each card's APR.

items.title: Total each loan offer
items.text: Monthly payment times the number of months, plus any fee.

items.title: Total the card route
items.text: What you'd pay putting the same monthly amount toward the cards.

items.title: Compare the totals
items.text: If the loan total isn't clearly lower, it isn't doing much for you.

images.after: Checking your rate is different from applying
images.title: Rate check vs full application
images.alt: Flow from checking your rate with a soft credit pull, to seeing estimates, to applying with a hard pull, to receiving the final offer.
images.caption: Only the full application touches your credit, so you can compare estimates from several lenders first.
images.note: Confirm each lender uses a soft pull for its rate check.

items.label: Check your rate
items.text: A soft credit pull. It doesn't affect your credit score.

items.label: See estimates
items.text: Rates and terms based on what you entered. Not an approval.

items.label: Apply
items.text: The lender requests your full credit report, a hard pull.

items.label: Final offer
items.text: Read the fee, late-payment and prepayment terms before accepting.
